title: Flags (staff)
body:
Syntax: rset flags | rset flags <name>
        mset <mob vnum> flags [name|-name]
        oset <object vnum> flags [name|-name]

Without a flag name, RSET/MSET/OSET FLAGS display the valid choices and current selections.

Room flags: Apartment (purchasable home), PlayerShop (purchasable shop room), Safe (PvP protection), CapturePoint, accelerated_healing, no_wander, furnace.

Biome flags: biome_ocean, biome_river, biome_lake, biome_forest, biome_mountain, biome_desert, biome_swamp, biome_plains. Short names such as RSET FLAGS FOREST also work. One biome at a time: choosing another replaces the last. Entering the active biome flag again removes it, leaving the room without a biome. Gathering and elemental jutsu use the selected biome. The old RSET BIOME and RSET APARTMENT ON/OFF commands are retired.

An owned apartment/shop room cannot lose its ownership flag until its owner sells it, and the apartment and player-shop flags cannot both be enabled on the same room.

MOB FLAGS control NPC merchant types, banking, training, aggression and other behaviors. ITEM FLAGS include AutoBalance, invis, no_sac and no_take. Prefix - to remove mob/item flags.

Date: 2026-11-15
